name: shoulder-pin-press
instructions:
1. Adjust the safety pins to shoulder height while standing.
2. Set the bar on the pins, load the desired weight, and stand directly beneath the bar with a shoulder width stance.
3. Place your hands at (or just outside of) shoulder width with a pronated grip.
4. Inhale, brace your abs, tuck your chin, and push the bar into the rack as press overhead to lockout.
5. Exhale once the bar gets to lockout and reverse the movement slowly while controlling the bar back to the pins.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
